notes: LUOI AN TOAN CFG AUTH (Sep duyet 10/8 — ca Thach/Hang: NV dang lam viec binh thuong bong vang ra man dang nhap vi cfg localStorage bi tac nhan ngoai xoa [phan mem don may/antivirus/trinh duyet thu hoi storage], pull truot la ket vinh vien): (1) setAuthConfig ghi kem BAN DU PHONG vao IndexedDB 'seahorse_auth_bk' — phan mem don rac thuong chi quet localStorage, chua IDB; (2) boot: mat ban chinh → TU PHUC HOI tu IDB + toast, NV lam viec tiep khong ket; (3) nut 'Su co cau hinh' dat co refresh_pending, GIU nguyen ban IDB — pull moi that bai vi mang → _authCfgUndoRefresh HOAN TAC ve cfg cu ngay tai man login (het canh bam nham roi ket ngoai cua); pull/luu thanh cong → xoa co.
